title: Nested QMC designs on spheres
summary: Nested cubature rules, in which each refinement retains all previously used nodes and thus reuses earlier function evaluations, are natural in multilevel and adaptive integration. For every fixed $s>d/2$, we show that the equal-weight QMC integration rate on $\mathbb S^d$ is compatible with such nested point sets. In the subcritical range $d/2 1$. At and above the critical index $s=d$, where the block-averaging estimate no longer yields the optimal rate, we prove an equal-weight completion theorem based on low-frequency discrepancy cancellation.
